CustomField.description: Quality of leads purchased in the last 7 days. Shows the % of purchased traffic that is high-quality. A low percentage means the customer received a higher volume of Tier 500 (low-quality) leads. Updated daily by Analytics. S3P-1330 - Created as part of Customer Health Initiative S3P-1388 - Helptext updated.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Quality of leads purchased in the last 7 days. Shows the % of purchased traffic that is high-quality. A low percentage means the customer received a higher volume of Tier 500 (low-quality) leads (Red: <15%, Yellow: 15-50%, Green: >50%). Updated daily by Analytics.
CustomField.label: Lead Quality
